extraction.name: WebWalkerQA
extraction.description: A benchmark designed to assess the ability of LLMs to perform web traversal. It evaluates the capacity of LLMs to traverse a website's subpages to extract high-quality data systematically.
extraction.creator: Jialong Wu, Wenbiao Yin, Yong Jiang, Zhenglin Wang, Zekun Xi, Runnan Fang, Linhai Zhang, Yulan He, Deyu Zhou, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: A two-stage funnel annotation strategy combining LLM-based and human annotation. First, official websites are traversed recursively to collect sub-links and pages. GPT-4o constructs queries based on the page information. Finally, human annotators verify, filter, rewrite, and calibrate the questions and answers.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Software Collection, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Root official websites across conference, organization, education, and game domains, initially identified through Google search and manual filtering.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Verify and filter for legitimate queries that deviate from natural, human-like phrasing, retaining only QA pairs with short answers containing entities.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: GPT-4o performs initial annotations to generate synthetic queries. Crowd-sourced human annotators then rewrite and calibrate the questions and answers to ensure the QA pairs are correct and consistent.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Dataset size is limited to 680 high-quality QA pairs. The environment only utilizes HTML-DOM to parse clickable buttons and lacks visual modalities such as screenshots.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating LLMs on their ability to handle queries embedded in complex, multi-step web interactions on a given root website (Web Traversal).
